question: A company is earning an income from which expenditure (other than tax) is deducted to get the amount of profit earned. The company has to pay tax of 22% on the profit earned. If net profit after paying taxes is Rs. 2,340, which is 18% of expenditure (other than taxes), what was the income (in Rs) of the company?
solution:
**Given:**

Net profit after paying taxes = Rs. 2,340

Net profit = 18% of expenditure (other than taxes)

Tax rate on profit = 22%

**Formula Used:**

Net profit = Profit after tax

Profit after tax = Profit before tax × (1 - Tax rate)

Income = Expenditure + Profit before tax
